description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and utility functions related to screen connection management in the Cuttlefish project, including configuration access, frame rendering, and frame information structures.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorInfo
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving screen configuration details such as count, dimensions, and size calculations.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorFrameRenderer
classes.description: Abstract interface for rendering confirmation UI on a screen and checking callback status.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorFrameInfo
classes.description: Data structure representing information about a processed screen frame, including display number and success status.

methods.name: BytesPerPixel
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per pixel, fixed at 4.

methods.name: ScreenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of available screens based on configuration.

methods.name: ScreenHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of a specified display.

methods.name: ScreenWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a specified display.

methods.name: ComputeScreenStrideBytes
methods.description: Calculates the stride in bytes for a given width.

methods.name: ComputeScreenSizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates the total size in bytes for a given width and height.

methods.name: ScreenStrideBytes
methods.description: Returns the stride in bytes for a specific display.

methods.name: ScreenSizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the total size in bytes for a specific display.

methods.name: ChkAndGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current Cuttlefish configuration, ensuring it exists.

methods.name: RenderConfirmationUi
methods.description: Pure virtual method to render confirmation UI on a display.

methods.name: IsCallbackSet
methods.description: Checks if the callback is set for the frame renderer.
